content.title: A Look at BeOne Medicines (ONC) Valuation Following Breakthrough FDA and Project Orbis Milestones
content.summary: BeOne Medicines (NasdaqGS:ONC) announced that its investigational drug sonrotoclax has received Breakthrough Therapy Designation from the U.S. FDA for relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma. content.title: Why BeOne Medicines (ONC) Is Up After FDA Breakthrough Tag and Project Orbis Review for Sonrotoclax
